mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') AS date, emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_experience_analysis WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d'), emotion ORDER BY date

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND emotion = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positiveCount, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND emotion = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutralCount, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND emotion = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negativeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS preTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND emotion = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prePositiveCount FROM tb_ai_experience_analysis WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{doubleDays} DAY)
SELECT focus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_experience_analysis WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY focus ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT focus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_ai_experience_analysis WHERE attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND emotion = 2 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY focus ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT a.focus, m.content FROM tb_ai_experience_analysis a JOIN SPRING_AI_CHAT_MEMORY m ON m.conversation_id = a.conversation_id WHERE a.attraction_id = #{attractionId} AND a.emotion = 2 AND m.type = 'USER' AND a.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY a.focus, m.content ORDER BY a.focus, RAND() LIMIT 500
